english.title: Cause use of a hand-held mobile phone/ device while driving a motor vehicle on a road - endorseable offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) to drive a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), when

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

was at the time using

(C)_[a hand-held mobile telephone]_

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 110(2) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41D of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from 25th March 2022 due to changes made by SI 2022/81. For the offence applying before this date, see H18723.
(ii) This is an endorseable offence , seeSchedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
(iii) Officers should note the defences to this offence, as provided by regulation 110(5) and (5A) and (5B) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986.

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.Discretionary disqualification.
